column1: # THE TYPER SLICE'S STAGE 1B, PART 1.1: 172 KEYS ADDED TO rust/oracles/identity/hits.tsv (AND THEIR IDS), ATTRIBUTED
# (2026-11-16; docs/rust-port/PHASE3.md, the typer slice's stage 1b; PHASE3_SHIM_DESIGN.md section 10 rulings 34 and 37
# (a)). Stage 1a's two complete probe v2 runs at c759ca718 (P1, P1b) answered 172 keys the freeze did not hold; their
# folders were deleted, their key lists kept (port-scratch/typer/runs/P1*.compare2.json). Two fresh complete runs at
# b12c55f87 (Z1, Z2: each its own tagged copy of rust/tools/identity-hits-probe-v2.patch, every hunk checked to apply;
# 143 of 145 targets passing each, the two probe-caused failures //core:census and //core:guardrails) answered all
# 73,476 frozen keys, all equal, none moved or absent, and agree on exactly those 172 keys (port-scratch/typer1b/tools/
# freeze172.py: the candidates, in both runs and outside the Postgres lanes, are P1's and P1b's set key for key; the
# tool re-derives every store byte for byte with nothing added). No answer changed: corpus growth. 148 keys are the
# questions of test texts added to core/src/test since the last keys were added (0f4f0d0b0), each matched to its test
# class by the probe's own model id (t: the text's SHA-256, s: the sources' "m.pure" NUL text, read from the string
# constants of the compiled test classes: port-scratch/typer1b/tools/cpool_texts.py) or, for a text a test builds,
# by the class of the row before it in its lane's file (rows are written in the order the tests run). 24 are
# //core:ladder_report's (12 programFacts, 12 database-judge test plans), which the freeze's rule left out until now
# as "a build action the cache answers": since every probe run is its own tagged copy (one unused constant naming the
# run), the action reruns in each run -- Z1, Z2, P1 and P1b each collected 0 files older than the run -- so its
# answers are two runs' like any lane's. Ids: 20 MirJson rows (19 new texts in mir-store.tsv), 16 plan rows (4 new
# execution plans in execution-plans.tsv; 12 new database-judge test plans, archived only:
# commit, oracle file, kind, model, query, doors, use, the text (test class; how it was matched), why the key is new.
